description: Catholic University of Leuven: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Leuven. Coverage: Catholic University of Leuven. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Données de réplication pour: Sous-stations hybrides: Rénovation HX-HP ; Données de réplication pour: Producteur de chaleur conjoint, conduites; Observations de ceilomètre prises à la station Princess Elisabeth, Dro; Observations MRR prises à la station Princess Elisabeth, Dronning Maud. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
